annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the quantity of tokens in thousands across different categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled as Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and Blogs, with the labels arranged from left to right in a specific order without any apparent sorting such as alphabetical or numerical. The vertical axis represents the number of tokens in thousands (K), with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10000 and tick marks labeled at intervals of 2000. Each bar is a light blue color and labeled with the token count at the top. The Administrative category has a value of approximately 6472, Religion has 652, Non-fiction is at 1889, Fiction shows 387, Law registers 354, News has the tallest bar at 10584, Science stands at 1626, and Blogs with the shortest bar at 32. None of the bars are visually emphasized beyond the basic color and labeling, and there are no grouped or stacked arrangements in this chart.
